test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'DETECT' is written as 'FCVCER' and 'HEIGHT' is written as ‘JCKEJR’. How will 'MOTHER' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed by the given series is:

 
• **Alphabets at odd places are increased to 2 positional values.**
 
• Alphabets at even places are decreased to 2 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d359b4e31afe959405ccd9cf5d1483fedbe6d29678a200d3ed30e8a4c46dee5f.png] **DETECT becomes FCVCER**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad12b82841ac18a97a64b92e34169d43041622caf6a52c71c8725df54a4d1139.png] **HEIGHT becomes JCKEJR**

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13184772f1d3c193dd48bfb3b76ac2d4ecd8edc1079464cf3c9ac43dfb50c32f.png] MOTHER becomes OMVFGP**

**Hence,** **the correct answer is option 4.**
